#side .kg { display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: center; gap: 9px; pointer-events: auto; }
/* WHY: Settings can move the keys to the left side. HOW: when body has data-side='left', row-reverse flips the order of */
/* the two groups. IMPROVE: none needed. */
body[data-side="left"] #side { flex-direction: row-reverse; }        /* Settings > "Side of the arrow keys" = left swaps the groups */
/* WHY: the round 3D key look. HOW: width and height equal - -key and border-radius 50% make a circle; min-width:0 and */
/* padding:0 cancel the normal button rules; radial-gradient makes a light spot (a dome); box-shadow adds a solid edge */
/* under it (thickness), a soft shadow, and inset highlights. IMPROVE: add a click sound. */
#side .key {
  width: var(--key); height: var(--key); min-width: 0; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1;      /* round 13: smaller symbol for the leaner key */
  color: var(--fg);
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 34% 26%, var(--keyhi) 0%, var(--keytop) 46%, var(--keyedge) 150%);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--keyedge), 0 10px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, .30),
              inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, .55), inset 0 -3px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .12);
  transition: transform .06s, box-shadow .06s;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
/* WHY: tiny label text under a symbol on a key. HOW: block, very small capital letters with a little letter-spacing and */
/* 1px top margin. IMPROVE: hide on very small phones. */
#side .key small { display: block; font-size: .44rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 1px; }
/* WHY: show a hover hint. HOW: the border becomes the accent colour. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#side .key:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
/* WHY: pressed look like a real key. HOW: when pressed (or JavaScript adds the class 'pressed') the key moves down 4px */
/* and the shadow becomes thin, so it looks pushed in. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#side .key:active, #side .key.pressed {
  transform: translateY(4px);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--keyedge), 0 3px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .25), inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, .4), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15);
}
/* WHY: show that a reload is running. HOW: class 'spin' makes the symbol orange and rotates it with the keyspin */
/* animation (a full turn each .9s, forever). The next line defines that rotation. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#side .key.spin { color: var(--accent); animation: keyspin .9s linear infinite; }     /* shown while a reload is running */
@keyframes keyspin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
/* WHY: make keys smaller on small phones so five fit in a row. HOW: at 520px or less the key size variable becomes 44px, */
/* margins and gaps shrink. The next rule does the same at 370px (40px). The last rule stops the key spin for */
/* reduced-motion users. IMPROVE: use clamp() for a smooth size. */
@media (max-width: 520px) { #side { --key: 38px; left: 8px; right: 8px; } #side .kg { gap: 7px; } }
@media (max-width: 370px) { #side { --key: 34px; } #side .kg { gap: 5px; } }          /* very small phones: the five keys still fit in one row */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #side .key.spin { animation: none; } }

/* ---------- 9. CHAPTER DROPDOWN ---------- */
/* WHY: the chapter list pop-up. HOW: fixed below the title bar on the right; z-index 40; width is the smaller of 360px */
/* or the screen minus 16px; max-height 62vh with overflow:auto adds scrolling for long lists; theme colours, border, */
/* radius and shadow. IMPROVE: add a search box. */
#chapterMenu {
  position: fixed; top: calc(124px + var(--safe-t)); right: 8px; z-index: 40;
  width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 16px)); max-height: 62vh; overflow: auto;
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
/* WHY: the download buttons inside the menu. HOW: full width (minus margins), shown as blocks with 6px margin. IMPROVE: */
/* none needed. */
#chapterMenu .dl-menu { display: block; width: calc(100% - 12px); margin: 6px; }
/* WHY: the list of chapters. HOW: list-style:none removes bullet dots; margin 0 and padding 6px for neat spacing. */
/* IMPROVE: none needed. */
#chapterList { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 6px; }
/* WHY: each chapter entry is a flat button. HOW: full width, left-aligned text, no border, small radius, 44px tall for */
/* tapping; nowrap + ellipsis cut long names. The next rule colours the current chapter orange with white text. IMPROVE: */
/* scroll to the current chapter when opened. */
#chapterList button {
  display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; border: 0; border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 44px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
#chapterList button.current { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }

/* ---------- 10. TOAST, BUSY, SETTINGS ---------- */
/* WHY: the small message pop-up (toast). HOW: fixed at bottom centre; starts invisible (opacity 0), 20px lower and not */
/* clickable; dark background with white text. The transition animates the fade and slide. IMPROVE: add an icon for */
/* success or error. */
#toast {
  position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: calc(80px + var(--safe-b)); transform: translate(-50%, 20px);
  max-width: min(92vw, 520px); padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 10px;
  background: #222; color: #fff; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 60;
  transition: opacity .25s, transform .25s;
}
/* WHY: show the toast. HOW: when JavaScript adds the class 'show', opacity becomes 1 and it moves up to its place. */
/* IMPROVE: none needed. */
#toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
/* WHY: a full-screen overlay while the app is busy. HOW: fixed with inset:0 covers everything; z-index 55; flex centres */
/* the message; - -bar background is see-through. IMPROVE: add a spinner inside. */
/* ROUND 59 (owner report): the note used to cover the WHOLE screen and block taps ("detection overlaps the site"). It is now a small pill at the bottom that lets every tap through (pointer-events: none). */
#busy {
  position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 74px; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 55; max-width: 88vw;
  padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 13px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: center;
  background: var(--bar); border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.25); pointer-events: none;
}
#busy[hidden] { display: none; }
/* WHY: the shared look of all pop-up dialogs. HOW: the width is the smaller of 92% of the screen or 480px; max-height */
/* 90dvh with overflow:auto scrolls inside; theme border, radius, colours and padding. Browsers colour dialogs by */
/* default, so colours are set here. IMPROVE: none needed. */
dialog { width: min(92vw, 480px); max-height: 90vh; max-height: 90dvh; overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); padding: 18px; }
/* WHY: the dark layer behind an open dialog. HOW: ::backdrop is made by the browser for <dialog>; 50% black. IMPROVE: */
/* add a blur. */
dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5); }
/* WHY: spacing for form fields inside dialogs. HOW: labels are blocks with space around; selects get a theme look; .row */
/* puts buttons in a row with space between. IMPROVE: none needed. */
dialog label { display: block; margin: 12px 0 4px; }
dialog select { min-height: 36px; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
dialog .row { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 16px; }

/* ---------- 10c. SETTINGS DIALOG: FITS ONE SCREEN (round 9) ----------
   WHY: the settings used to be one long column, so you had to scroll inside it. Now the options sit in cards in a grid.
   HOW: .set-grid is a CSS grid with auto-fit columns: 4 columns on a big monitor, 2 on a tablet, 1 on a phone. The dialog
        is as wide as the screen allows and never taller than the screen. app.js fitSettings() measures it: if the cards
        still do not fit, it adds the class "tabs" and only the selected card is shown (the tab row appears). So you never
        need to scroll, on any size, and no option is removed.
   WHERE: markup in index.html (<dialog id="settings">); the switch is app.js fitSettings() and the tab clicks in section 15.
   IMPROVE: remember the last used tab; let the user drag the cards into a different order. */
/* WHY: the settings dialog should be wide so the cards fit one screen. HOW: width up to 1180px (or 98% of the screen), */
/* max-height 96dvh, tighter padding than normal dialogs. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#settings { width: min(98vw, 1180px); max-height: 96vh; max-height: 96dvh; padding: 12px 14px; }
/* WHY: the header of the settings with title and tabs. HOW: flex row with space between, wraps on small screens. h3 has */
/* no margin. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#settings .set-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
#settings h3 { margin: 0; }
/* WHY: the tab buttons are only needed when cards do not fit. HOW: hidden by default (display:none); shown as flex when */
/* #settings has class 'tabs' (line below). Active tab is orange. Round pills with 36px height. IMPROVE: remember the */
/* last tab. */
#setTabs { display: none; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }                 /* only shown in tab mode */
#setTabs button { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 99px; }
#setTabs button.active { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; }
#settings.tabs #setTabs { display: flex; }
/* WHY: in tab mode only one card should show. HOW: cards without the class 'active' are hidden. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#settings.tabs .set-card:not(.active) { display: none; }                /* tab mode: one card at a time */
/* WHY: lay the setting cards in a responsive grid. HOW: grid with repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)) makes as many */
/* columns of at least 200px as fit; gap 10px; align-items:start keeps cards at their own height. IMPROVE: none needed. */
.set-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px; align-items: start; }   /* round 11: 200 px so FIVE cards (with Troubleshoot) still sit side by side on a 1100 px window */
/* WHY: each card (fieldset) groups related settings. HOW: thin border, rounded, small padding, no margin; min-width:0 */
/* lets it shrink. Legend is the card title in bold. IMPROVE: none needed. */
.set-card { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 10px 8px; margin: 0; min-width: 0; }
.set-card legend { font-weight: 600; padding: 0 6px; }
/* WHY: compact spacing so everything fits without scrolling. HOW: tighter margins for labels, help text, rows, buttons */
/* (36px tall), the range row gap and the inline row. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#settings label { margin: 6px 0 2px; }
#settings .muted.small { margin: 4px 0; }
#settings .row { margin-top: 10px; }
#settings button { min-height: 36px; }
#settings .rg-row { gap: 8px; }
#settings .inline { margin-top: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
/* WHY: a long proxy list must not make the dialog taller. HOW: max-height 24vh (24% of screen height) with overflow:auto */
/* gives the list its own scrollbar. #secList below only adds a small top margin. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#settings #proxyList { max-height: 24vh; overflow: auto; }              /* a long proxy list scrolls on its own, the dialog does not grow */
#settings #secList { margin-top: 4px; }
/* WHY: very short windows have no room for long help text. HOW: if the screen is 560px high or less, hide the small */
/* muted help lines but keep all controls. IMPROVE: show help on a tap instead. */
@media (max-height: 560px) { #settings .muted.small { display: none; } }  /* very short windows: hide the long help texts, keep every control */

/* Proxy list in Settings. Each row: proxy name, a small status text, and a remove button. */
/* WHY: the proxy box in Settings looks like the other cards. HOW: thin rounded border, padding, no margin; the legend is */
/* bold. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#proxyBox { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px 10px; margin: 0; }
#proxyBox legend { font-weight: 600; padding: 0 6px; }
/* WHY: the proxy list. HOW: no bullets; a flex column with 6px gaps. Each li row is a flex row with a border and rounded */
/* corners. IMPROVE: add drag to reorder. */
#proxyList { list-style: none; margin: 6px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
#proxyList li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 2px 4px 2px 10px; }
/* WHY: show each proxy name and status neatly. HOW: .pname grows, cuts long text with ... and uses a small monospace */
/* font (same-width letters); .pstate does not grow, can take 40% at most; the remove button is 34px tall with no border. */
/* IMPROVE: colour the status text. */
#proxyList .pname { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font: 12px ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; }
#proxyList .pstate { flex: none; max-width: 40%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
#proxyList button { min-height: 34px; border: 0; }
/* WHY: a common row with an input and a button side by side. HOW: flex row, 6px gap; the input grows and may shrink. */
/* IMPROVE: none needed. */
.inline { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 6px; }
.inline input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

/* ---------- 10b. PDF DOWNLOAD PANEL ----------
   WHY: a centred card with a progress bar while the PDF is being built (can take minutes for many chapters).
   IMPROVE: show the estimated file size and time left. */
/* ---------- DOWNLOAD DOCK + RANGE DIALOG (round 7) ----------
   WHY: the download must stay visible (and not block reading) while chapters are fetched.
        The dock floats in the bottom corner (the opposite side of the reader keys); the pill is the minimised form.
   HOW: #dock.min hides the list and shows only the pill. The pill's ring is a conic-gradient filled by the CSS
        variable --p (0-100) that app.js sets while a job runs. Jobs are <li class="dl-job">.
   WHERE: markup in index.html (#dock, #rangeDlg); logic in app.js sections 12b and 12c.
   IMPROVE: make the dock draggable, add a sound or notification when a file is ready. */
/* WHY: the download progress bar. HOW: .dl-bar is a 10px grey track with round ends; the <i> inside is the orange fill; */
/* JavaScript sets its width and it animates over .2s. IMPROVE: show percent text. */
.dl-bar { height: 10px; margin: 8px 0 6px; background: var(--line); border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; }
.dl-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--accent); transition: width .2s; }
/* ROUND 8: the dock sits right ABOVE the reader keys, in the same corner. column-reverse puts the open list above the round pill. */
/* WHY: the floating download dock. HOW: fixed in the bottom corner (right 12px) above the keys; z-index 60; width up to */
/* 380px; flex with column-reverse puts the open list above the round pill. IMPROVE: make it draggable. */
#dock { position: fixed; right: 12px; left: auto; bottom: calc(18px + var(--safe-b)); z-index: 60; width: min(380px, calc(100vw - 24px));
  display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; align-items: flex-end; }
/* WHY: follow the key side setting. HOW: if keys are on the left, the dock moves to the left too and aligns to the */
/* start. IMPROVE: none needed. */
body[data-side="left"] #dock { right: auto; left: 12px; align-items: flex-start; }
/* WHY: the dock must not cover the keys. HOW: in reading mode, bottom is the key row height plus gaps (14+5+50+14px) */
/* plus the safe area; outside reading mode it sits 86px up, above the Reading mode button. IMPROVE: use a variable for */
/* the key height. */
body.reading #dock { bottom: calc(14px + 5px + 40px + 14px + var(--safe-b)); }          /* above the key row */
body:not(.reading) #dock { bottom: calc(86px + var(--safe-b)); }                        /* above the Reading mode button */
/* WHY: the list box inside the dock. HOW: fills the dock width. Later rules style it as a card. IMPROVE: merge duplicate */
/* #dockBox rules. */
#dockBox { width: 100%; }
/* WHY: show a finished download. HOW: a done pill gets a green ring (#2f9e44) and a bold green arrow. IMPROVE: none */
/* needed. */
#dockIcon.done .ring { background: #2f9e44; }
#dockIcon.done .arrow { color: #2f9e44; font-weight: 800; }
/* WHY: make the open dock list look like a card. HOW: theme background, border, rounded corners, shadow, 8px gap below, */
/* max height 55vh with scrolling. The next line hides it when the dock is minimised (class min). IMPROVE: none needed. */
#dockBox { background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); margin-bottom: 8px; max-height: 55vh; overflow: auto; }
#dock.min #dockBox { display: none; }
/* WHY: the dock title row. HOW: flex row with space between; the close button has no border and a small height. IMPROVE: */
/* none needed. */
.dock-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 8px 0 14px; }
.dock-head button { border: 0; min-width: 40px; min-height: 36px; }
/* WHY: the list of download jobs. HOW: no bullets, flex column with 10px gaps. Each job (.dl-job) is a small bordered */
/* card. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#dockList { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 4px 10px 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.dl-job { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; }
/* WHY: layout of a job card. HOW: .dj-top puts title and size on one line; .dj-title cuts long names with ...; .dj-size */
/* keeps its width, uses same-width digits (tabular-nums) and orange bold text; .dj-btns holds buttons on the right and */
/* wraps. IMPROVE: none needed. */
.dj-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.dj-title { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.dj-size { flex: none; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
.dj-btns { display: flex; gap: 6px; justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 6px; }
.dj-btns button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; }
/* WHY: colour the progress bar by job state. HOW: attribute selectors read data-status: done = green; error or cancelled */
/* = red. IMPROVE: add a yellow colour for paused. */
.dl-job[data-status="done"] .dl-bar i { background: #2f9e44; }
.dl-job[data-status="error"] .dl-bar i, .dl-job[data-status="cancelled"] .dl-bar i { background: #c92a2a; }
/* WHY: the minimised round download pill. HOW: flex row with icon and label, 48px tall, round (99px), theme colours and */
/* shadow. The next lines continue the same rule. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#dockIcon { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-left: 0; padding: 4px 14px 4px 4px; min-height: 48px; border-radius: 99px;
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow); color: var(--fg); }
/* WHY: the progress ring. HOW: a 38px circle; conic-gradient paints a pie: orange for - -p percent (calc(var(- -p) * */
/* 1%)) and grey for the rest; JavaScript updates - -p. Lines 403-404 repeat the same values (harmless duplicate). */
/* IMPROVE: delete the duplicates. */
#dockIcon .ring { --p: 0; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: conic-gradient(var(--accent) calc(var(--p) * 1%), var(--line) 0); }
#dockIcon { --p: 0; }
#dockIcon .ring { background: conic-gradient(var(--accent) calc(var(--p) * 1%), var(--line) 0); }
/* WHY: the arrow in the middle of the ring. HOW: a 28px round circle with theme background that sits over the ring */
/* centre (display:grid + place-items:center centres it). IMPROVE: none needed. */
#dockIcon .arrow { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--bg); }
/* WHY: show activity while downloading. HOW: when busy, the arrow bobs up and down using the bob animation; the next */
/* line moves it 2px at the midpoint. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#dockIcon.busy .arrow { animation: bob 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes bob { 50% { transform: translateY(2px); } }
/* WHY: a small count badge on the pill. HOW: :not(:empty) means it only shows when it has text; orange pill with white */
/* small text. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#dockCount:not(:empty) { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border-radius: 99px; padding: 0 7px; font-size: .75rem; }
/* WHY: respect reduced-motion for the bobbing arrow. HOW: turn the animation off in that setting. IMPROVE: none needed. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #dockIcon.busy .arrow { animation: none; } }

/* Range dialog + memory / security boxes in the settings. */
/* WHY: the chapter range chooser. HOW: .chips is a wrapping flex list of small buttons with a max-height of 128px and */
/* scrolling; .chip is a round 34px button. IMPROVE: add select-all. */
.chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; max-height: 128px; overflow: auto; margin: 8px 0; }
.chip { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: .9rem; }
/* WHY: put two selects (from / to) side by side. HOW: .rg-row is a flex row; each label shares space equally; selects */
/* fill their label. IMPROVE: none needed. */
.rg-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
.rg-row label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.rg-row select { width: 100%; }
/* WHY: memory and security boxes in Settings look like the other cards. HOW: thin rounded border, padding, no margin, */
/* bold legends. label.check puts a checkbox beside its text. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#memBox, #secBox { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px 10px; margin: 0; }
#memBox legend, #secBox legend { font-weight: 600; padding: 0 6px; }
label.check { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 8px 0; }
/* WHY: the list in the security box. HOW: no bullets, flex column with 4px gaps. The last rule removes extra margin */
/* between two stacked menu buttons. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#secList { list-style: none; margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
#chapterMenu .dl-menu + .dl-menu { margin-top: 0; }

/* ---------- 11. BIG ERROR POP-UP (round 8) ----------
   WHY: errors must be impossible to miss and easy to copy. It is a modal <dialog>: centred, red border, with a plain
        one-line summary, a hint, and the full report in a selectable text box.
   IMPROVE: add a "Retry" button that repeats the action that failed. */
/* WHY: the error pop-up must be impossible to miss. HOW: wide dialog (max 760px) with a thick 3px dark-red border; the */
/* title is red; the summary is bold and breaks long words (word-break) so it does not overflow; hint has a small margin. */
/* IMPROVE: add a Retry button. */
#errbox { width: min(96vw, 760px); border: 3px solid #b3261e; }
#errbox h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #b3261e; font-size: 1.45rem; }
#errSummary { margin: 0 0 6px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; word-break: break-word; }
#errHint { margin: 0 0 10px; }
/* WHY: the full error report in a box that is easy to copy. HOW: a full-width textarea that can be resized vertically, */
/* small monospace font, theme colours; user-select:text makes sure the text can be selected. IMPROVE: add a Copy button. */
#errText {
  width: 100%; resize: vertical; font: 12px/1.4 ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace;
  background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px;
  -webkit-user-select: text; user-select: text;
}

/* ---------- 12. FAILED PAGE + CLEARED CHAPTER NOTICES (round 8) ----------
   WHY: a picture that cannot load used to be an empty grey box. Now it says so and offers Retry / Open picture. */
/* WHY: a picture that failed to load shows a clear message. HOW: centred grey text with padding and a light red tint; */
/* its .row holds the Retry / Open buttons in a centred row; links use the accent colour. Redefined in round 11. IMPROVE: */
/* auto-retry once. */
.page-fail { text-align: center; padding: 36px 14px; color: var(--muted); background: rgba(179, 38, 30, .08); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.page-fail .row { display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; margin-top: 10px; }
.page-fail a { color: var(--accent); }
/* WHY: the notice shown after a chapter is cleared (to free memory). HOW: centred grey text with generous padding. */
/* IMPROVE: add an Undo button. */
.ch-cleared { text-align: center; color: var(--muted); padding: 40px 14px; }

/* ---------- 13. ROUND 8 EXTRAS ----------
   WHY: (1) while you scroll down the round keys fade away; the download dock then slides down so it does not float
        in empty space, and it STAYS visible (a download must always be checkable).
        (2) the dock pill shows red when a download failed.
   IMPROVE: make the dock draggable. */
/* WHY: let the dock slide smoothly. HOW: transition on bottom makes a change of position animate over .25s. When reading */
/* and scrolling, the dock moves down to 18px; the next lines colour an error pill red. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#dock { transition: bottom .25s; }
body.reading.scrolling #dock { bottom: calc(18px + var(--safe-b)); }
#dockIcon.err .ring { background: #c92a2a; }
#dockIcon.err .arrow { color: #c92a2a; font-weight: 800; }
/* The short notice ("Download started...") must not cover the round download button, so in reading mode it floats higher. */
/* WHY: keep the short message from covering the download button. HOW: in reading mode, the toast sits 150px higher. */
/* IMPROVE: none needed. */
body.reading #toast { bottom: calc(150px + var(--safe-b)); }

/* ROUND 9b: the clear (x) button INSIDE a search box. WHY: pasting a new link meant deleting the old one by hand. HOW: the
   input gets extra right padding, the button floats over that spot and only shows when the box has text (app.js). */
/* WHY: a wrapper so the clear (x) button can sit inside the input. HOW: position:relative lets the button be placed */
/* inside it; flex layout; the input gets extra right padding so text does not go under the x. IMPROVE: none needed. */
.inwrap { position: relative; flex: 1; display: flex; min-width: 0; }
.inwrap input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding-right: 38px; }
/* WHY: the clear (x) button. HOW: position:absolute puts it at the right, top 50% with translateY(-50%) centres it */
/* vertically; small round grey button; min-height:0 cancels the global button rule. The next line hides it when the */
/* hidden attribute is set. IMPROVE: none needed. */
.clearx { position: absolute; right: 4px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 30px; height: 30px; min-height: 0; padding: 0;
  border-radius: 50%; border: 0; background: var(--line); color: var(--fg); font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
.clearx[hidden] { display: none; }

/* ROUND 9b (phones): the "End reading" words are hidden on narrow screens (only the x stays) so the manga title gets room.
   Selects in the settings cards may never be wider than their card. */
/* WHY: save space on phones. HOW: on 520px or narrower the text label of the Exit button is hidden so only the x */
/* remains; settings selects are never wider than their card. IMPROVE: none needed. */
@media (max-width: 520px) { #btnExit .lbl { display: none; } }
#settings select { max-width: 100%; }


/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 10 ADDITIONS
   WHY / HOW / IMPROVE are written next to each block.
   ===================================================================== */

/* The clear (x) button inside a search box: SMALL and FIXED size now (22 px), so it never stretches with the box.
   WHY: it was too big. HOW: explicit width/height, flex:none, min-* reset so the global 44 px button rule cannot grow it. */
/* WHY: make the x smaller and fixed. HOW: 22px width and height, min-* sizes reset, flex:none so it never stretches, */
/* smaller font. This overrides the earlier .clearx rule because it comes later. IMPROVE: delete the older .clearx rule */
/* to avoid confusion. */
.clearx { width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; min-height: 22px; flex: none; right: 8px; font-size: .62rem; padding: 0; line-height: 22px; }
.inwrap input { padding-right: 36px; }

/* "top" key: it uses the same .key rules as the reload keys (round 3D look). Only the little label needs a rule. */
/* WHY: the 'top' key symbol is a little bigger than text keys. HOW: only the font size is set; all other looks come from */
/* .key. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#side .k-top { font-size: 1.25rem; }

/* DOWNLOAD BUTTON that is always there in reading mode (minimised round pill above the arrow keys).
   WHY: you asked for it to be visible like the arrow keys and to hide when you scroll down (class ui-hide does that).
   HOW: while nothing is downloading only the round icon shows; while a job runs the ring fills, the arrow bobs and a glow
   pulses (the "notification"); green when a PDF is ready, red on a failure. */
/* WHY: the download pill should be small when idle. HOW: when it is not busy, done or error, the label is hidden and */
/* padding is smaller so only the round icon shows. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#dockIcon:not(.busy):not(.done):not(.err) #dockLabel { display: none; }
#dockIcon:not(.busy):not(.done):not(.err) { padding: 4px; }
/* WHY: tell the user a download is running. HOW: while busy, the dockglow animation pulses an orange glow ring around */
/* the pill (box-shadow grows and shrinks). It is turned off for reduced-motion users. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#dockIcon.busy { animation: dockglow 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes dockglow { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: var(--shadow); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(232, 89, 12, .28), var(--shadow); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #dockIcon.busy { animation: none; } }

/* Range dialog: estimated size line. Colour says how big: normal / big (orange) / huge (red). */
/* WHY: show the estimated download size in the range dialog. HOW: a bordered rounded box with bold small text. The next */
/* rules read data-level: big = orange tint, huge = red tint. small text inside is grey and on its own line. IMPROVE: add */
/* a warning icon. */
.rg-size { margin: 8px 0 2px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); font-weight: 600; font-size: .92rem; }
.rg-size[data-level="big"] { border-color: #e8590c; background: rgba(232, 89, 12, .08); }
.rg-size[data-level="huge"] { border-color: #c92a2a; background: rgba(201, 42, 42, .09); }
.rg-size small { display: block; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }

/* START PAGE (digital look): hero card, steps, avatar cards. Plain CSS only. */
/* WHY: widen the start page a bit (overrides the 720px set earlier). HOW: a later rule with the same selector wins. */
/* IMPROVE: merge with the first #start rule. */
#start { max-width: 860px; }
/* WHY: the colourful hero card at the top of the start page. HOW: rounded card with white text on a purple-to-orange */
/* diagonal gradient; background-size 160% lets the herodrift animation slowly move the gradient; a purple shadow adds */
/* depth. The animation is turned off for reduced-motion users. IMPROVE: use theme colours. */
.hero { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 26px 20px 20px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 22px; text-align: center;
  color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b2bd9 0%, #7a2cf0 48%, #e8590c 130%); background-size: 160% 160%;
  animation: herodrift 14s ease-in-out infinite; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(60, 40, 200, .28); }
@keyframes herodrift { 50% { background-position: 100% 60%; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .hero { animation: none; } }
/* WHY: hero text pieces. HOW: h2 is a big heading that scales with screen width; the badge is a small see-through pill; */
/* the sub-text is slightly faded (opacity .9). IMPROVE: none needed. */
.hero h2 { margin: 6px 0 4px; font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 4.6vw, 2rem); line-height: 1.15; }
.hero-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .18); font-weight: 700; font-size: .85rem; }
.hero-sub { margin: 0 0 14px; opacity: .9; }
/* WHY: the big search form in the hero. HOW: a flex row with the box and the button; max-width 640px centred; the input */
/* is tall (48px) with white background and rounded corners; the clear button gets light-grey colours to show on white. */
/* IMPROVE: none needed. */
#heroForm { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; }
#heroForm .inwrap { flex: 1; }
#heroForm input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; border: 0; font-size: 16px; background: #fff; color: #111; }
#heroForm button { min-height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; }
#heroForm .clearx { background: #e5e5ea; color: #333; }
/* WHY: small status pills in the hero (for example proxy state). HOW: .status-chips is a centred wrapping row; each */
/* .chip2 is a see-through white pill with white small bold text. IMPROVE: none needed. */
.status-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 12px; }
.status-chips .chip2 { padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .2); color: #fff; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .3); min-height: 0; }
/* WHY: the how-it-works steps. HOW: .steps is a grid with as many columns of at least 170px as fit; each .step is a */
/* bordered card in a column; b is the round numbered circle in orange; span is the bold step name; small is grey help */
/* text. IMPROVE: add icons. */
.steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.step { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--bg); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.step b { width: 26px; height: 26px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font-size: .85rem; }
.step span { font-weight: 700; margin-top: 4px; }
.step small { color: var(--muted); }
/* WHY: the history list as cards. HOW: .list.cards becomes a grid with columns at least 240px wide, filling the row. */
/* IMPROVE: none needed. */
.list.cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
/* WHY: make each item a row with an avatar and text. HOW: !important forces row layout and centre alignment over the */
/* earlier .list .item rules. IMPROVE: remove the older rule so !important is not needed. */
.item { flex-direction: row !important; align-items: center !important; gap: 10px !important; }
/* WHY: the coloured letter avatar in each item and its text block. HOW: .av is a 40px rounded square that centres a bold */
/* white letter; .tx is a column that can shrink so long text is cut. IMPROVE: use the site favicon. */
.item .av { flex: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.item .tx { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; }
/* WHY: hover feedback for cards. HOW: the border turns orange and the card lifts 1px. IMPROVE: add a transition to make */
/* it smooth. */
.item:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-1px); }

/* ROUND 10 fix: the search-bar rules (".rb-search button { min-height: 40px }") were making the clear (x) button tall.
   A more specific selector (.inwrap .clearx) wins and pins it to 22 x 22 px everywhere. */
/* WHY: fix the clear x being tall in the search bar. HOW: .inwrap .clearx is more specific than .rb-search button, so it */
/* wins and pins the size to 22x22px. IMPROVE: rely less on specificity by renaming the classes. */
.inwrap .clearx { width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; min-height: 22px; max-height: 22px; line-height: 20px; padding: 0; }


/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 11 ADDITIONS
   WHY / HOW / IMPROVE are written next to each block.
   ===================================================================== */

/* 1. THE SLIDER REPLACES THE UP / DOWN ARROW KEYS.
   WHY: you asked to remove the up and down arrow keys once the vertical slider exists above the End key.
   HOW: chapter-slider.js adds the class "has-slider" to <body>. Only then are the two keys hidden, so without the slider file
        you still have them (and the Left / Right keyboard keys, the chapter list and "n" / "p" always work).
   IMPROVE: a Settings switch "show the arrow keys as well". To bring the keys back for good delete the next two lines. */
/* WHY: when the slider exists, the up and down arrow keys are not needed. HOW: only when body has class 'has-slider' */
/* (added by chapter-slider.js) both buttons are hidden. IMPROVE: add a Settings switch to show them again. */
body.has-slider #btnPrev, body.has-slider #btnNext { display: none; }

/* 2. DOWNLOAD BUTTON NEXT TO THE END KEY (when the slider is linked).
   WHY: the slider now sits right above the End key, exactly where the round download button used to be.
   HOW: the dock moves to the LEFT of the End key in the same bottom row (End key width + gaps); sizes follow the keys in section 8. */
/* WHY: move the download dock next to the End key when the slider is used. HOW: in reading mode with the slider, the */
/* dock sits to the left of the End key (12px + 50px key + 12px from the right); the left-side version mirrors it; while */
/* scrolling, it stays at the same bottom. IMPROVE: use CSS variables instead of repeated numbers. */
body.reading.has-slider #dock { right: calc(12px + 40px + 12px); bottom: calc(14px + var(--safe-b)); }
body[data-side="left"].reading.has-slider #dock { right: auto; left: calc(12px + 40px + 12px); }
body.reading.has-slider.scrolling #dock { bottom: calc(14px + var(--safe-b)); }
/* WHY: keep the dock beside the End key when keys are smaller. HOW: the 520px rule uses 44px keys and 8px gaps; the */
/* 370px rule uses 40px keys; each also has a left-side version. IMPROVE: use var(- -key) to avoid repeating numbers. */
@media (max-width: 520px) { body.reading.has-slider #dock { right: calc(8px + 38px + 8px); } body[data-side="left"].reading.has-slider #dock { left: calc(8px + 38px + 8px); right: auto; } }
@media (max-width: 370px) { body.reading.has-slider #dock { right: calc(8px + 34px + 6px); } body[data-side="left"].reading.has-slider #dock { left: calc(8px + 34px + 6px); right: auto; } }

/* 3. THE REPORT BUTTON ON THE LAST CHAPTER + THE TROUBLESHOOT DIALOG. */
/* WHY: the Report button on the last chapter and the Troubleshoot dialog. HOW: a small round button next to the */
/* chapter-end text; #fixDlg is a wide dialog (max 820px) with spaced headings. IMPROVE: none needed. */
.ch-end .ch-report { min-height: 32px; margin-left: 6px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: .8rem; border-radius: 99px; }
#fixDlg { width: min(96vw, 820px); }
#fixDlg h4 { margin: 14px 0 6px; }
/* WHY: collapsible sections in the troubleshoot dialog. HOW: <details> gets a thin border and rounded corners; summary */
/* has the hand cursor, bold text, and is a flex row so it is easy to tap; an open section gets an orange border. */
/* IMPROVE: none needed. */
#fixDlg details { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 10px; margin: 6px 0; }
#fixDlg summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; min-height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
#fixDlg details[open] { border-color: var(--accent); }
/* WHY: tidy lists in the troubleshoot dialog. HOW: inline rows wrap; .fix-prompts and .fix-recent are lists without */
/* bullets in a column with gaps; prompt items have a border; <pre> wraps long lines, uses small monospace text, limited */
/* to 9em tall with scrolling. IMPROVE: add Copy buttons. */
#fixDlg .inline { flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 6px 0; }
.fix-prompts, .fix-recent { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.fix-prompts li { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; }
.fix-prompts pre { white-space: pre-wrap; margin: 6px 0; font: 12px/1.4 ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; max-height: 9em; overflow: auto; color: var(--muted); }
.fix-recent li { font-size: .85rem; }
/* WHY: the fix list scrolls on its own. HOW: no bullets, limited to 26vh high with overflow:auto; each item has small */
/* vertical padding. The last line lets the error box buttons wrap. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#fixList { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 6px 0; max-height: 26vh; overflow: auto; }
#fixList li { padding: 2px 0; }
#errbox .row { flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* 4. READING MODE, DIGITAL LOOK (round 11).
   WHY: the start page got a digital look in round 10; you asked for the reading mode to follow, without changing it too much and
        with a friendlier interface.
   HOW: only colours, borders, glows and sizes change. No button moved. Everything uses the theme variables, so light and dark both work.
        - title bar: soft glass with a thin accent line under it, bigger touch targets (44 px)
        - progress line: accent gradient with a small glow
        - chapter header: number in a pill, accent line on top of every chapter card
        - end of chapter: a dashed "digital" divider
        - keys: accent ring when hovered or pressed, same shapes as before
   IMPROVE: a compact / comfortable switch in Settings, per-site accent colour, a mini map of chapters in the bar. */
/* WHY: give the reader bar a glass look. HOW: background is a gradient of the same colour (a placeholder that keeps the */
/* bar see-through); the bottom border is removed and replaced by a thin line plus a soft shadow. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#readerBar { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bar), var(--bar)); border-bottom: 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--line), 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .10); }
/* WHY: a thin coloured line under the bar. HOW: ::after creates an extra element at the bottom, 2px tall, filled with a */
/* gradient that fades in and out at both ends (transparent to orange to purple to transparent) at 65% strength. IMPROVE: */
/* none needed. */
#readerBar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent), #7a2cf0, transparent); opacity: .65; }
/* WHY: bigger, friendlier buttons in the bar. HOW: 44px minimum size, rounded 12px; the hover rule colours the border */
/* orange. The title gets slightly bigger text with a little letter-spacing. IMPROVE: none needed. */
.rb-row button, .rb-search button { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; border-radius: 12px; }
.rb-row button:hover, .rb-search button:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.rb-title h1 { font-size: 1.02rem; letter-spacing: .01em; }
/* WHY: show the sub-title as a purple pill. HOW: inline-block with padding, round corners, a see-through purple */
/* background; the font shorthand sets weight, size and line-height together with monospace letters. IMPROVE: none */
/* needed. */
#rSub { display: inline-block; margin-top: 2px; padding: 1px 10px; border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(122, 44, 240, .12); color: var(--fg);
  font: 600 .72rem/1.5 ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; }
/* WHY: make the progress line a bit thicker and prettier. HOW: height 4px; the fill is an orange-purple-blue gradient */
/* with a glow (box-shadow) and a rounded right end. IMPROVE: none needed. */
#progress { height: 4px; }
#progress i { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #7a2cf0, #25a8ff); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(122, 44, 240, .7); border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; }
/* WHY: a colourful line on top of every chapter card. HOW: border-top is 3px transparent, and border-image paints a */
/* gradient over it (the 1 means use the image as it is). The phone rule repeats it because the earlier phone rule */
/* removes borders. IMPROVE: remove the repeated rule if not needed. */
.chapter { border-top: 3px solid transparent; border-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #7a2cf0, #25a8ff) 1; }
@media (max-width: 700px) { .chapter { border-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #7a2cf0, #25a8ff) 1; } }
/* WHY: a friendlier chapter header. HOW: a faint purple gradient fades from top to transparent; .ch-num becomes a pill */
/* with a border, theme background and soft purple shadow. IMPROVE: none needed. */
.ch-head { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(122, 44, 240, .07), transparent); }
.ch-num { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 18px; border-radius: 99px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(122, 44, 240, .15); }
/* WHY: a digital style for the chapter end and message buttons. HOW: the end gets a dashed top line and small monospace */
/* bold text; the buttons in messages are round pills 40px tall; failed pages get a dashed red border and soft red tint. */
/* IMPROVE: none needed. */
.ch-end { border-top: 2px dashed var(--line); font: 600 .85rem ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .03em; }
.ch-msg .row button, .page-fail .row button { min-height: 40px; border-radius: 99px; padding: 0 16px; }
.page-fail { border: 1px dashed #c92a2a; border-radius: 12px; margin: 8px 10px; background: rgba(201, 42, 42, .06); }
/* WHY: key focus and hover glow. HOW: the border turns orange and an extra purple ring (0 0 0 3px) is added to the */
/* shadow list, keeping the original 3D shadows so the key shape does not change. Line 596 removes the default outline */
/* for focus because the glow replaces it. IMPROVE: keep a visible outline for accessibility checks. */
#side .key:hover, #side .key:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--keyedge), 0 0 0 3px rgba(122, 44, 240, .25), 0 10px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, .30), inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, .55), inset 0 -3px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .12); }
#side .key:focus-visible { outline: none; }
/* WHY: style the load-earlier button and chapter menu like the rest. HOW: round pill with orange border; the menu gets */
/* rounder corners and an orange border; the current chapter gets a soft orange-purple gradient and bold text. IMPROVE: */
/* none needed. */
#prevBar button { border-radius: 99px; border-color: var(--accent); }
#chapterMenu { border-radius: 14px; border-color: var(--accent); }
#chapterList button.current { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(232, 89, 12, .18), rgba(122, 44, 240, .12)); font-weight: 700; }
/* WHY: a slim scrollbar that matches the theme. HOW: scrollbar-width: thin makes the bar narrow; scrollbar-color sets */
/* the thumb to orange and the track to transparent (works in Firefox and new Chrome). IMPROVE: add -webkit-scrollbar */
/* rules for older Safari. */
html { scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--accent) transparent; }


/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 12: ALIGNMENT ON EVERY DEVICE + THE WHEEL CORNER + THE DOWNLOAD LIST ON PHONES
   WHY: (1) the two reload keys were replaced by the reload wheel in the bottom-left corner, so the Top key must sit BESIDE it.
        (2) on a phone the open download list (380 px wide) was pushed off the left edge because the dock sits beside the End key.
        (3) phones with a notch / rounded corners / sideways use need the safe-area margins on the left and right too.
   HOW: body.has-wheel (set by reload-wheel.js) adds a left margin to the Top key group equal to the wheel width (--mfw, defined by
        reload-wheel.js on body). The open #dockBox becomes a bottom sheet (fixed, 8 px from both sides, above the key row) on screens
        up to 700 px wide. Left / right margins use max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-*)).
   IMPROVE: let the user drag the wheel and the dock to any corner and remember it. */
/* WHY: keep every floating item inside the visible screen. HOW: the strip and the dock use the larger of 12 px and the notch inset. */
#side { left: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); right: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-right)); }
#dock { max-width: calc(100vw - 16px); }
/* WHY: room for the wheel. HOW: margin-left on the left key group (the Top key); mirrored when the buttons are on the left. */
body.has-wheel #side .kg-l { margin-left: 0; }       /* round 14: the wheel now sits ABOVE the Top key, so no side margin */
body.has-wheel[data-side="left"] #side .kg-l { margin: 0; }
/* WHY: the Top key was a reload-key partner; keep it vertically centred with the End key. HOW: nothing to add, the group aligns centre. */
@media (max-width: 520px) { #side { left: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); right: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-right)); } }
/* WHY: the open download list must always fit on a phone / small tablet. HOW: bottom sheet above the key row (reading mode) or above the pill (start page). */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  #dock:not(.min) #dockBox { position: fixed; left: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); right: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-right)); width: auto;
    bottom: calc(14px + 5px + 40px + 14px + 56px + var(--safe-b)); max-height: min(55dvh, 420px); margin: 0; z-index: 61; }
  body:not(.reading) #dock:not(.min) #dockBox { bottom: calc(86px + 56px + var(--safe-b)); }
}
/* WHY: short screens (phone turned sideways) must not hide the list behind the keys. HOW: lower height cap. */
@media (max-height: 430px) { #dockBox { max-height: 60dvh; } #dock:not(.min) #dockBox { max-height: 60dvh; bottom: calc(14px + 5px + 38px + 8px + var(--safe-b)); } }
/* WHY: dialogs (settings, error report, troubleshoot) must fit any screen. HOW: never wider than the screen minus 16 px, never taller than the visible height. */
dialog { max-width: calc(100vw - 16px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 16px); }


/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 13: SWITCHING THE ADD-ONS OFF + LEANER LOOK
   WHY: Settings > Reading has two switches (slider, wheel). Off means hidden AND not usable.
   HOW: app.js puts body.no-slider / body.no-wheel; these rules win over the add-ons' own display rules (!important).
   IMPROVE: remove the elements from the page instead of hiding them. */
body.no-slider #mfSlider, body.no-wheel #mfWheel { display: none !important; pointer-events: none !important; }
/* WHY: the keys got smaller (40 px), so their 3D edge and shadow are thinner too. HOW: lighter shadow numbers. */
#side .key { box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--keyedge), 0 8px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .28), inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, .5), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, .12); }
#side .key:active, #side .key.pressed { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--keyedge), 0 3px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .25), inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, .4); transform: translateY(3px); }

/* ROUND 13: the two add-on switches share one line so the Reading card stays short (all five cards still fit on a big screen). */
.check-pair { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .check-pair .check { margin: 0; }


/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 14: LAYOUT + CLEAR BUTTON + SMALL KEYS WITHOUT WORDS
   WHY: (1) the x in the search boxes jumped when pressed: the global rule  button:active { transform: scale(.96) }  REPLACED the
            transform that centred it (translateY(-50%)), so it dropped half its height while you pressed it.
        (2) the layout asked for: LEFT corner = Top key at the bottom with the reload wheel right above it; RIGHT corner = End key at
            the bottom with the chapter slider right above it (see chapter-slider.js); the download button moves to the top right,
            just below the title bar, and is smaller.
   HOW: (1) the x is centred with margin instead of transform and every state keeps  transform: none ; an invisible ::before makes
            the touch area bigger than the 22 px circle. (2) in reading mode the dock is pinned with top (below the bar) and the
            open list hangs under the round button; when the bar slides away (body.scrolling) the dock rises with it.
   IMPROVE: make the dock draggable and remember where you left it. */
.inwrap .clearx { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 50%; margin: -11px 0 0; transform: none !important; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; touch-action: manipulation; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
.inwrap .clearx:hover, .inwrap .clearx:active, .inwrap .clearx:focus { transform: none !important; }
.inwrap .clearx::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -11px; }            /* bigger invisible touch area (44 x 44) */
/* WHY: the bottom corner keys carry no words any more (only the symbol). HOW: hide any leftover <small> label. */
#side .key small { display: none; }
/* WHY: download button at the top right under the title bar (reading mode only). HOW: !important beats the older dock rules. */
body.reading #dock { top: calc(124px + var(--safe-t)) !important; bottom: auto !important; right: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-right)) !important; left: auto !important;
  flex-direction: column !important; align-items: flex-end !important; transition: top .25s; }
body.reading.scrolling #dock { top: calc(10px + var(--safe-t)) !important; }         /* follows the title bar when it slides away */
body.reading #dockBox { margin: 8px 0 0; }
body.reading #dockIcon { min-height: 34px; padding: 3px 10px 3px 3px; gap: 6px; font-size: .72rem; }
body.reading #dockIcon .ring { width: 28px; height: 28px; } body.reading #dockIcon .arrow { width: 20px; height: 20px; font-size: .8rem; }
body.reading #dockLabel { font-size: .72rem; } body.reading #dockCount:not(:empty) { font-size: .66rem; padding: 0 6px; }
/* the chapter list drop-down starts below the download button so they never cover each other */
body.reading #chapterMenu { top: calc(124px + 44px + var(--safe-t)); max-height: calc(100dvh - 124px - 44px - 80px - var(--safe-t) - var(--safe-b)); }
/* WHY: the open download list on a phone used to be a bottom sheet; now it hangs from the top. */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  body.reading #dock:not(.min) #dockBox { position: fixed; top: calc(124px + 44px + var(--safe-t)); bottom: auto; left: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); right: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-right)); width: auto; max-height: min(55dvh, 420px); margin: 0; }
  body.reading.scrolling #dock:not(.min) #dockBox { top: calc(10px + 44px + var(--safe-t)); }
}

/* ROUND 14: accent colour swatches (Settings > Reading). WHY: a quick "pro" way to restyle. HOW: five small round buttons, each paints itself
   with its own --c; the chosen one gets a ring. min-width/min-height 0 so the global 40px button size does not enlarge them. IMPROVE: a free colour picker. */
.accent-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 4px 0; }
.accent-row button { min-width: 0; min-height: 0; box-sizing: border-box; width: 26px; height: 26px; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); border: 2px solid transparent; }
.accent-row button.on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--c); }

/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 15: DIGITAL START PAGE + "PAGE MAY LOOK INCOMPLETE" NOTICE
   WHY: the start page should feel like a control panel, and a half-loaded website must say so (with a report button).
   HOW: a moving grid and a scan line are painted on the hero with gradients (no pictures, no scripts); the HUD strip and the scope switch are small
        flex rows with glowing "LED" dots. All motion stops for people who asked for reduced motion.
   IMPROVE: let people pick the neon colour in Settings.
   ===================================================================== */
/* WHY: the digital grid behind the hero text. HOW: two thin repeating lines (horizontal and vertical) in see-through white, drifting slowly; it sits
   behind the content (z-index 0 / content 1). */
.hero::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: .35;
  background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.16) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.16) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 28px 28px;
  animation: gridmove 9s linear infinite; }
/* WHY: a thin bright line that sweeps down the card (a "scanner"). HOW: a 2px gradient line moved by keyframes. */
.hero::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; top: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(127,246,255,.9), transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(127,246,255,.8); animation: scanline 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
.hero > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
@keyframes gridmove { to { background-position: 28px 28px; } }
@keyframes scanline { 0% { top: 0; opacity: 0; } 15% { opacity: 1; } 85% { opacity: 1; } 100% { top: 100%; opacity: 0; } }
/* WHY: neon look for the heading. HOW: text-shadow glow in light cyan. */
.hero h2 { text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(127,246,255,.55); letter-spacing: .01em; }
.hero-badge { border: 1px solid rgba(127,246,255,.6); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(127,246,255,.35); font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; }
#heroForm input { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(127,246,255,.45), 0 0 18px rgba(127,246,255,.3); }
/* WHY: the Manga / Everything switch. HOW: a small pill group; the chosen button is bright. min-width/min-height 0 so the global 40px button size does not enlarge it. */
.scope { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-top: 10px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.25); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25); font: 700 .68rem ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #cfe; }
.scope span { padding: 0 8px; opacity: .8; }
.scope button { min-width: 0; min-height: 0; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #fff; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.scope button.on { background: #fff; color: #2a1a9a; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(127,246,255,.7); }
/* ROUND 16: engine row. WHY: reuse the pill look of .scope; the select is a small dark-glass drop-down and the Google button is a plain pill. */
/* HOW: margin-left puts it beside the scope switch on wide screens; on phones the rows simply wrap. min-width/min-height 0 beat the global button size. */
.engine { margin-left: 8px; }
.engine select { min-height: 0; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); color: #fff; font: inherit; }
.engine select option { color: #111; background: #fff; }
.engine #googleBtn { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
/* WHY: the live status strip. HOW: a wrapping row of tiny monospace labels; .led is a glowing dot (green online, red offline); em is the clock. */
.hud { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 12px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; margin-top: 10px; font: 600 .68rem ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #d8f6ff; }
.hud i { font-style: normal; opacity: .85; } .hud em { font-style: normal; color: #7ff6ff; text-shadow: 0 0 8px #25a8ff; }
.hud .led { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; background: #51cf66; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #51cf66; animation: ledblink 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.hud .led.bad { background: #ff6b6b; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #ff6b6b; }
@keyframes ledblink { 50% { opacity: .45; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .hero::before, .hero::after, .hud .led { animation: none; } }
/* WHY: the "page may look incomplete" notice. HOW: a slim amber bar under the address bar with three small buttons; wraps on phones. */
#pageNote { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 8px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #fff3bf; color: #5c4400; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0c36d; font-size: .82rem; }
#pageNote[hidden] { display: none; }
#pageNote #pageNoteText { flex: 1 1 220px; }
#pageNote button { min-width: 0; min-height: 0; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: .78rem; }


/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 17 ADDITIONS
   ===================================================================== */
/* The clear (x) button: ONE fixed 22 x 22 circle in every search box (start page, address bar, popup, reader bar).
   WHY: "#heroForm button { min-height: 48px }" and "#popForm button { min-height: 46px }" are more specific than the older .clearx rules,
        so the x became a tall oval, was off-centre and seemed to jump when pressed.
   HOW: these selectors are even more specific and use !important for size and position; the box is centred with top:50% and a negative
        margin (no transform at all), nothing is animated, and the tap area is enlarged by an invisible ::before.
   IMPROVE: none needed. */
.inwrap .clearx, #heroForm .inwrap .clearx, #popForm .inwrap .clearx, .rb-search .inwrap .clearx, .rb-row .inwrap .clearx {
  position: absolute !important; right: 8px !important; top: 50% !important; bottom: auto !important; left: auto !important; margin: -11px 0 0 !important;
  width: 22px !important; height: 22px !important; min-width: 22px !important; min-height: 22px !important; max-width: 22px !important; max-height: 22px !important;
  padding: 0 !important; border-radius: 50% !important; line-height: 22px !important; font-size: .62rem !important; text-align: center;
  transform: none !important; transition: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
.inwrap .clearx:hover, .inwrap .clearx:active, .inwrap .clearx:focus { transform: none !important; top: 50% !important; margin: -11px 0 0 !important; }
/* The clipboard arrow beside the paste button + its drop-down list. */
/* WHY: the arrow opens the list of copied texts. HOW: .clipdd is a narrow button the same height as the paste button; #clipPop is a
   fixed card that app.js places under the arrow (z-index above the search popup); rows are one-line buttons. */
.clipdd { min-width: 34px !important; width: 34px; padding: 0 !important; font-size: .9rem; }
#heroForm .clipdd { min-height: 48px; }
#popForm .clipdd { min-height: 46px; }
#clipPop { position: fixed; z-index: 100000; box-sizing: border-box; max-height: min(60vh, 420px); overflow: auto; padding: 6px; border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--fg, #111); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dbe4); box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
#clipPop[hidden] { display: none; }
#clipPop button { min-width: 0; min-height: 0; font: inherit; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
#clipPop .clip-now, #clipPop .clip-clear { display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; }
#clipPop .clip-clear { color: #c92a2a; }
#clipPop .clip-now:hover, #clipPop .clip-clear:hover, #clipPop .clip-item:hover { background: rgba(127,127,127,.15); }
#clipPop .clip-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; }
#clipPop .clip-item { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
#clipPop .clip-del { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; text-align: center; opacity: .6; }
#clipPop .clip-empty { padding: 10px 12px; font-size: .85rem; opacity: .7; }
/* The engine row on narrow phones: the pills wrap under each other and the select stays small. */
@media (max-width: 480px) { .engine { margin-left: 0; } #heroForm { gap: 4px; } #heroForm #heroPaste { min-width: 40px; padding: 0 8px; } }

/* ROUND 17: the clipboard arrow glyph must be visible: the start-page buttons are white, so the arrow is dark there. */
#heroForm .clipdd, #popForm .clipdd, .clipdd { color: #222; background: #fff; border-radius: 14px; line-height: 1; }
[data-theme="dark"] #popForm .clipdd { color: #eee; background: var(--card, #2a2c36); }


/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 18 ADDITIONS  (Google panel, full screen, Top / End slider, settings card)
   WHY: every new feature of round 18 has its styles here, so nothing in the older rules was changed (a past update once moved other
        things by accident). Each block says which feature it belongs to.
   IMPROVE: when the design settles, merge these rules into the sections above.
   ===================================================================== */

/* ---- 1. GOOGLE SEARCH PANEL (#gview) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   WHY: Google draws its own search box and result list; this panel gives it a clean, scrollable home inside the page area.
   HOW: it fills #viewport (position:absolute) like the frame does; the bar on top stays visible while the results scroll. */
#gview { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 3; overflow: auto; background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); padding: 0 0 90px; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
#gview[hidden] { display: none; }
#gview .gv-bar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--bg); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
#gview .gv-bar b { flex: none; }
#gview .gv-bar #gvQuery { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
#gview .gv-bar button { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 99px; }
#gvStatus { padding: 6px 14px 0; }
#gvStatus:empty { display: none; }
#gvBox { max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 6px 10px; }
/* Google's own elements are light-coloured; keep them readable in the dark theme too. */
[data-theme="dark"] #gvBox { background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; margin-top: 8px; }

/* ---- 2. FULL SCREEN -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   WHY: "full screen" works like the F11 key. The title / address bars stay, the floating helpers (wheel, sliders, keys, downloads) hide.
   HOW: app.js puts body.fs while the browser is in full screen (button, Esc, or F11) and body.fs-small too on a phone / small tablet (round 29c: only there the
        helpers and the title bars hide; on a computer they stay). body.no-fs hides the buttons when the switch in Settings is off. body.fs-unsupported hides them in browsers that cannot do it (iPhone Safari). */
.fs-btn { white-space: nowrap; }
body.no-fs .fs-btn, body.fs-unsupported .fs-btn { display: none !important; }
/* ROUND 29c: the helpers (slider, wheel, Top / End slider, keys, download pill, Reading-mode button) hide in full screen ONLY on a phone / small tablet (body.fs-small, set by app.js
   syncFs). On a computer they stay, as the owner asked ("on a computer I want all the buttons"). */
body.fs.fs-small #mfSlider, body.fs.fs-small #mfWheel, body.fs.fs-small #mfEdge, body.fs.fs-small #side, body.fs.fs-small #dock, body.fs.fs-small #fabRead { display: none !important; }
/* ... and on a phone / small tablet the TITLE BARS go too (the reader bar with its buttons and search box, the address bar of the browse view): only the exit icon is left. They are
   position: fixed (reader bar) or the first row of a column (address bar), so hiding them gives the pictures / the page the whole screen. */
body.fs.fs-small #readerBar, body.fs.fs-small .navbar { display: none !important; }
/* the exit icon then moves up to the corner where the title bar was (the old place, under the download pill, is empty now) */
body.fs.fs-small.reading #fsRead { top: calc(10px + var(--safe-t, 0px)) !important; }
#chapterMenu .fs-btn { display: block; width: calc(100% - 12px); margin: 0 6px 6px; }
#dlBar .fs-btn { margin-top: 8px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; font-size: .95rem; }
/* The exit button: bottom centre, so it never covers the title bar or the right-hand controls. It fades after 3 s without movement. */
#fsExit { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: calc(18px + var(--safe-b, 0px)); transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 90; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 18px;
  border-radius: 99px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); background: rgba(20, 20, 28, .88); color: #fff; font: 600 .9rem system-ui, sans-serif;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .3s; }
#fsExit[hidden] { display: none; }
#fsExit.idle { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
body:not(.fs) #fsExit { display: none; }

/* ---- 3. TOP / END SLIDER (edge-slider.js) --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   WHY: the owner asked for a slider that replaces the Top and End keys and sits ABOVE the reload wheel.
   HOW: edge-slider.js adds body.has-edge only while it is linked AND switched on. Then (a) the two keys are hidden, (b) the wheel and the
        chapter slider drop to the corner where the keys were, and (c) the new slider stands on top of the wheel. Switch it off in
        Settings > Search & extras and everything returns to the old layout (keys visible, wheel above the Top key). */
body.has-edge #btnTop, body.has-edge #btnEnd { display: none !important; }
/* round 19: the wheel no longer sits at the bottom, see ROUND 19 block at the end. The chapter slider drops to the bottom because the End key is hidden: */
body.has-edge #mfSlider { bottom: calc(14px + var(--safe-b, 0px)) !important; }
body.no-edge #mfEdge { display: none !important; pointer-events: none !important; }

/* ---- 4. SETTINGS CARD "Search & extras" -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
#searchBox input[type="text"] { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 36px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); font: .85rem ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; }
#searchBox code { background: rgba(127, 127, 127, .18); padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

/* ---- 5. PAGES SHOWN WITHOUT THEIR SCRIPTS (renderFrame adds class mf-nojs to <html> inside the frame) --------------------------
   WHY: manga sites hide menus, pop-ups and chapter lists with CSS that a script switches on. We never run their scripts, so those
        pieces used to appear as raw text (theme drop-downs) or stayed hidden (chapter lists). The rules themselves are injected into the
        frame by app.js (MF_NOJS_CSS), not loaded from here. */


/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 19 ADDITIONS (reading-mode column at the top right, hide rules)
   WHY: the owner wants, in reading mode, one tidy column on the right under the title bar:
        download pill (existing #dock)  ->  full-screen ICON button (#fsRead)  ->  reload wheel (#mfWheel).
        The bottom of the right edge keeps the chapter slider and (beside it) the shorter Top / End slider.
   HOW: all three follow the same "top" number as the download pill, so they slide up together when the title bar hides on scroll down
        (the same behaviour as the pill) and come back on scroll up. Everything is fixed-position CSS only; no script moves them.
   IMPROVE: put the column's top offset into one CSS variable (--col-top) if the title bar height ever changes.
   ===================================================================== */
body { --col-top: calc(124px + var(--safe-t, 0px)); }
body.reading.scrolling { --col-top: calc(10px + var(--safe-t, 0px)); }
/* ROUND 20: the full-screen button has EXACTLY the size of the download pill (44 x 38 px, pill shape) and stands right under it. */
#fsRead { display: none; position: fixed; z-index: 60; width: 44px; height: 38px; min-height: 0; min-width: 0; padding: 0; border-radius: 999px;
  right: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-right)); top: calc(var(--col-top) + 38px + 8px); transition: top .25s; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1; place-items: center;
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow); color: var(--fg, inherit); cursor: pointer; }
body.reading #fsRead { display: grid; }
body.no-fs #fsRead, body.fs-unsupported #fsRead { display: none !important; }
/* ROUND 21: while in full screen the SAME icon button, in the SAME place, becomes the EXIT button (the old bottom "Exit" button is hidden in reading mode).
   It hides while you scroll down and comes back when you scroll up, like the other floating buttons. Esc and F11 still leave full screen too. */
body.fs.reading #fsRead { display: grid !important; top: calc(124px + var(--safe-t, 0px) + 38px + 8px); transition: opacity .25s, top .25s; }
body.fs.reading.scrolling #fsRead { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
body.fs.reading #fsExit { display: none !important; }
body.reading #dock { transition: top .25s; }
/* ROUND 20: the reload wheel is at the TOP LEFT under the title bar (the mirror of the download pill), in the same row as the pill */
body.reading #mfWheel { left: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-left)) !important; right: auto !important; bottom: auto !important;
  top: var(--col-top) !important; transition: top .25s, opacity .25s; }
body.reading #mfWheel .mf-tip { left: 0 !important; right: auto !important; top: 100%; bottom: auto; margin: 8px 0 0; }   /* the tip opens DOWNWARDS (there is no room above) */
body[data-side="left"].reading #mfWheel { left: max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-left)) !important; }
/* the old text buttons for full screen inside reading mode are replaced by the icon button */
body.reading #btnFsMenu, body.reading #btnFsDl { display: none !important; }

/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 19: DIGITAL POLISH FOR THE HEADER BUTTONS AND THE SETTINGS WINDOW
   WHY: the owner asked for friendlier, more "digital" buttons that work on every device. HOW: only look changes (no sizes that move other things):
        glowing hover / focus ring, a pressed effect, touch targets of at least 40 px, settings tabs as pill chips that scroll sideways on small screens,
        cards with a soft neon edge. Reduced-motion users get no animation. IMPROVE: move the colours into variables (--glow) for a theme maker.
   ===================================================================== */
header button, #chapterMenu button, #settings button { transition: box-shadow .18s, transform .12s, border-color .18s; }
header button:hover:not(:disabled), #settings button:hover:not(:disabled) { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent), 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent); }
header button:active:not(:disabled), #settings button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.96); }
header button:focus-visible, #settings button:focus-visible, #settings input:focus-visible, #settings select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
header button, #settings .inline button { min-height: 40px; }
#settings [role=tablist], #setTabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; padding-bottom: 4px; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
#settings [role=tab] { flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 14px; min-height: 36px; white-space: nowrap; }
#settings [role=tab].active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent); }
#settings .set-card { border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, var(--line)); }
#settings .set-card legend { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .03em; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { header button, #chapterMenu button, #settings button { transition: none; } }


/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 22
   1) The full-screen icon hides while you scroll down and returns when you scroll up (like the other floating buttons).
   2) Google's own pop-up / overlay (shown by Google's script when its engine is set to "Overlay") is never shown: results are drawn inside #gview or by MangaFlow's own list.
   ===================================================================== */
body.reading.scrolling #fsRead { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
#fsRead { transition: opacity .25s, top .25s; }
.gsc-overlay-wrapper, .gsc-modal-background-image, .gsc-overlay-wrapper-constraint { display: none !important; }

/* ROUND 28: the note under a chapter that could only be read in part ("Only 1 of 7 pictures of Chapter 1 could be found ...").
   WHY: it must stand out from a normal "Loading" message but must not look like a red error. HOW: a soft yellow dashed box (like .page-fail but yellow); the link and the two buttons
   share one row that wraps on a phone. IMPROVE: show which pages are missing. */
.ch-partial { margin: 8px 10px; padding: 18px 14px; border: 1px dashed #e0a800; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(224, 168, 0, .10); }
.ch-partial .row { flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
.ch-partial .row a { color: var(--accent); }
.ch-partial .row button { min-height: 40px; border-radius: 99px; padding: 0 16px; }


/* =====================================================================
   ROUND 29a - THE REOPEN COVER (no flash of the start page)
   WHY: after a refresh, or when the closed browser is reopened on the same page, the start screen used to flash for a second before the page came back (see boot.js).
   HOW: #resume is hidden normally. boot.js puts the class mf-resuming on <html> BEFORE the first paint when the address asks for a reopen; then #resume covers the whole screen
        (position: fixed, above everything including the toast) and app.js removes the class when the page is really ready (endResume). The colours come from the variables, so
        it is dark in dark mode (boot.js also sets the theme early). IMPROVE: a soft fade-out instead of an instant removal.
   ===================================================================== */
#resume { display: none; }
html.mf-resuming #resume {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 2147483000;       /* above the toast, the dialogs and the Google panel */
  background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg);
}
html.mf-resuming #resume p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: 15px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; }
html.mf-resuming body { overflow: hidden; }            /* nothing scrolls behind the cover */
/* ROUND 30: the way out of a slow reopen. boot.js shows #resumeSlow (it has the attribute hidden until then) when the cover has stood for resumeSlowMs. */
#resumeSlow { text-align: center; margin-top: 14px; padding: 0 16px; }
#resumeSlow[hidden] { display: none; }
#resumeSlow button { min-height: 44px; border-radius: 99px; padding: 0 20px; margin-top: 10px; }


/* ============================================================
   ROUND 29e - THE "VERIFY YOU ARE HUMAN" BOX AND THE WAITING CHAPTER BOXES
   WHY: a page behind a Cloudflare check can only be passed by a person. The dialog (#verifyBox) is for a page you open; .ch-verify is the box a waiting CHAPTER shows while reading.
   HOW: the dialog copies the look of #errbox but in the accent colour (it is not an error, it is a step for you). Buttons wrap on a phone and keep a 44 px touch height.
