/* =====================================================================
   MangaFlow - accounts-worker.js   (round 14: now uses a Cloudflare D1 database; replaces the round-13 KV version)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   WHY it exists:
     profiles.js (the profile icon on the home page) works WITHOUT any server (profiles then live in one browser). With THIS Worker
     your data lives in the cloud instead, so:
       * every profile has its OWN history, bookmarks, "continue reading" list and recent pages, on every device;
       * the ADMIN (you) can open every profile: status (last seen, counts), history, bookmarks;
       * error reports ("bug reports") that signed-in people send are stored here so the admin can read them.
     A normal profile can only ever read its own data. Only the admin name and code you set in the Worker variables can read all.
   HOW to link it (about 6 minutes, nothing to code - the tables are created by the Worker itself on its first call):
     1. Cloudflare dashboard > Storage & databases > D1 SQL database > Create database. Name it  mangaflow  (any name works).
     2. Workers & Pages > Create > Create Worker. Name it  mangaflow-accounts . Press Deploy, then Edit code, delete the sample code,
        paste THIS whole file, press Deploy.
     3. That Worker > Settings > Bindings > Add > D1 database. Variable name must be exactly   DB   . Pick the database from step 1. Save.
     4. That Worker > Settings > Variables and Secrets > Add:
            ADMIN_USER = the admin name you want (3-20 letters or digits, for example  dharma)       type: Text
            ADMIN_CODE = your 6-digit admin code                                                       type: Secret
            ALLOWED_ORIGINS = https://YOURNAME.github.io   (optional but recommended; comma separated) type: Text
            PEPPER = any long random text (optional, one more secret mixed into the stored code fingerprints)   type: Secret
        Deploy again after adding variables.
     5. Open the Worker address (https://mangaflow-accounts.YOURNAME.workers.dev/ping with a POST is needed, so just copy the address)
        and paste it into MangaFlow: home page > profile icon > Server > paste > Save > Test (it must say "ready, admin is set").
     6. Sign in with ADMIN_USER and ADMIN_CODE. You now see the tabs  All profiles  and  Bug reports .
   WHAT is stored (nothing else): user names, a salted SHA-256 fingerprint of each code (never the code), created / last-seen times, the
     last 1000 history items per profile (kind, manga title, chapter, address, time), one small JSON "state" per profile (bookmarks,
     continue-reading list, recent pages) and the bug reports people chose to send (the report text, max 8000 characters).
   LIMITS (free plan): D1 gives about 100 000 writes and 5 000 000 reads a day and 5 GB - plenty for a private site. History is sent in
     batches (profiles.js sends them about 8 seconds after the first new row, and when the page is hidden), not item by item.
   SAFETY (honest): a 6-digit code has only a million possibilities, so protection is: 5 wrong tries lock the name for 15 minutes, the
     optional PEPPER, and ALLOWED_ORIGINS. Do not reuse a code you use anywhere important.
   IMPROVE: PBKDF2 hashing on the paid plan (more CPU time), e-mail recovery, daily clean-up with a Cron Trigger, per-day activity charts.
   ===================================================================== */

// WHY: how many bug reports are kept in total. HOW: the oldest are deleted first. IMPROVE: delete reports older than 90 days.
const MAX_BUGS = 300;
// WHY: wrong-code protection. HOW: after FAIL_LIMIT wrong tries a name is locked for FAIL_SECONDS. IMPROVE: also lock per IP address.
const FAIL_LIMIT = 5, FAIL_SECONDS = 900;

const TOKEN_SECONDS = 30 * 24 * 3600;
// WHY: the biggest "state" JSON (bookmarks, reading lists) accepted per profile, in characters. IMPROVE: compress it.
const MAX_STATE = 150000;

// WHY: the table definitions. HOW: run once per Worker start with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, so you never have to use the SQL console.
const SCHEMA = [
  'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, salt TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL, created INTEGER, last INTEGER)',
  'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user TEXT NOT NULL, t INTEGER, type TEXT, title TEXT, chapter TEXT, url TEXT, host TEXT)',

  'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bugs (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user TEXT, t INTEGER, title TEXT, report TEXT, page TEXT)',

      if (f && f.until > now && f.n >= FAIL_LIMIT) return json({ error: 'Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes.' }, 429, cors);
      let role = null;
      if (adminName && user === adminName) { if (env.ADMIN_CODE && same(code, env.ADMIN_CODE)) role = 'admin'; }      // the admin lives in the variables, not in the table
      else {
        const rec = await DB.prepare('SELECT salt, hash FROM users WHERE name = ?').bind(user).first();
        if (rec && same(await fingerprint(env, rec.salt, user, code), rec.hash)) { role = 'user'; await DB.prepare('UPDATE users SET last = ? WHERE name = ?').bind(now, user).run(); }
      }
      if (!role) {
        const n = (f && f.until > now ? f.n : 0) + 1;
        await DB.prepare('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO fails (name, n, until) VALUES (?, ?, ?)').bind(user, n, now + FAIL_SECONDS * 1000).run();
        return json({ error: 'Wrong name or code.' }, 401, cors);
      }
      await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM fails WHERE name = ?').bind(user).run();
      // ROUND 20: the admin gets a normal row in the users table (random unusable fingerprint: the real login above never reads it) so the admin's own history,
      // bookmarks and "last seen" are listed and counted exactly like any other profile. WHY: before, the admin had no row, so "All profiles" never showed the admin.
      if (role === 'admin') await DB.prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (name, salt, hash, created, last) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)').bind(user, random(8), random(32), now, now).run();
      await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM tokens WHERE exp < ?').bind(now).run();                                         // tidy up old sign-ins
      return json({ token: await newToken(DB, user, role, now), user, role }, 200, cors);
    }

    // --- everything below needs a sign-in ------------------------------------------------------
    const me = body.token ? await DB.prepare('SELECT user, role FROM tokens WHERE token = ? AND exp > ?').bind(txt(body.token, 64), now).first() : null;
    if (!me) return json({ error: 'Please sign in again.' }, 401, cors);
    const admin = me.role === 'admin';

    // WHY: sign out. HOW: delete this token so it can never be used again.
    if (path === '/logout') { await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM tokens WHERE token = ?').bind(txt(body.token, 64)).run(); return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors); }

    // --- add history items (sent in batches by the app). ROUND 19: the admin's own reading is saved too (it was skipped before). ------
    if (path === '/act') {
      const items = (Array.isArray(body.items) ? body.items : []).slice(0, 100);
      // WHY: nothing to save. HOW: answer ok without touching the database.
      if (!items.length) return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors);
      await DB.batch(items.map(x => DB.prepare('INSERT INTO acts (user, t, type, title, chapter, url, host) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)')
        .bind(me.user, +x.t || now, txt(x.type || 'read', 12), txt(x.title, 120), txt(x.chapter, 80), txt(x.url, 400), txt(x.host, 80))));
      await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM acts WHERE user = ? AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM acts WHERE user = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?)').bind(me.user, me.user, MAX_ACTS).run();
      await DB.prepare('UPDATE users SET last = ? WHERE name = ?').bind(now, me.user).run();
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors);
    }

    // --- my own history and data -----------------------------------------------------------------
    if (path === '/me') {
      const rows = (await DB.prepare('SELECT t, type, title, chapter, url, host FROM acts WHERE user = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?').bind(me.user, MAX_ACTS).all()).results.reverse();
      return json({ user: me.user, role: me.role, items: rows }, 200, cors);
    }
    // the profile's own "state": bookmarks, continue-reading list, recent pages (one small JSON text)
    if (path === '/state/get') { const s = await DB.prepare('SELECT json, updated FROM state WHERE user = ?').bind(me.user).first(); return json({ json: s ? s.json : '', updated: s ? s.updated : 0 }, 200, cors); }
    if (path === '/state/put') {
      const j = typeof body.json === 'string' ? body.json : JSON.stringify(body.json || {});
      // WHY: protect the database from huge uploads. HOW: refuse texts longer than MAX_STATE with status 413.
      if (j.length > MAX_STATE) return json({ error: 'The saved lists are too big.' }, 413, cors);
      await DB.prepare('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO state (user, json, updated) VALUES (?, ?, ?)').bind(me.user, j, now).run();
      return json({ ok: true, updated: now }, 200, cors);
    }
    // a bug report the person chose to send (any signed-in profile, also the admin)
    if (path === '/bug') {
      await DB.prepare('INSERT INTO bugs (user, t, title, report, page) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)').bind(me.user, now, txt(body.title, 160), txt(body.report, 8000), txt(body.page, 300)).run();
      await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM bugs WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM bugs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?)').bind(MAX_BUGS).run();
      // WHY: tell the app the bug report was stored. HOW: a plain ok answer. IMPROVE: return the report id.
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors);
    }
    if (path === '/clear-me') { await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM acts WHERE user = ?').bind(me.user).run(); return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors); }

    // --- ROUND 38: delete ONE activity entry from the cloud (profiles.js delact handler). ----------------------------
    // WHY: when the user taps × on a history entry in the profile tab, it should also disappear from the cloud,
    //   not just from their browser. HOW: match by user + timestamp + url. All three must match so random people
    //   cannot delete each other's rows. IMPROVE: add an integer id to the history rows so delete is instant.
    if (path === '/activity/delete') {
      const t = +body.t || 0, url = txt(body.url, 400);
      // WHY: refuse if the caller did not give us the timestamp or url (both needed to identify the row).
      if (!t || !url) return json({ error: 'Need t and url.' }, 400, cors);
      await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM acts WHERE user = ? AND t = ? AND url = ?').bind(me.user, t, url).run();
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors);
    }

    // --- ROUND 38: wipe ALL activity entries for this user from the cloud (profiles.js clear handler). ---------------
    // WHY: the user clicked "Clear history" in the profile tab — delete everything from the cloud too,
    //   not just from the browser's localStorage. HOW: same SQL as /clear-me but reached via a different
    //   route so profiles.js can call it without touching the older /clear-me path. IMPROVE: add a "confirm" flag.
    if (path === '/activity/clear') {
      await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM acts WHERE user = ?').bind(me.user).run();
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors);
    }

    if (path === '/delete-me') {
      if (admin) return json({ error: 'The admin lives in the Worker variables.' }, 400, cors);
      await wipe(DB, me.user); await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM tokens WHERE user = ?').bind(me.user).run();
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors);
    }

    // --- ADMIN only ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (path.startsWith('/admin/')) {
      if (!admin) return json({ error: 'Admin only.' }, 403, cors);
      if (path === '/admin/users') {
        // WHY: one query gives the admin list with counts per profile. HOW: sub-selects count reads, downloads and bugs; a LEFT
        // JOIN brings the saved lists so bookmarks can be counted. IMPROVE: keep counts in their own table for speed.
        const r = await DB.prepare(`SELECT u.name AS user, u.created, u.last,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acts a WHERE a.user = u.name AND a.type = 'read') AS reads,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acts a WHERE a.user = u.name AND a.type = 'download') AS downloads,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bugs b WHERE b.user = u.name) AS bugs, s.json AS state
          FROM users u LEFT JOIN state s ON s.user = u.name ORDER BY u.last DESC LIMIT 500`).all();
        return json({ users: r.results.map(u => { let marks = 0; try { marks = (JSON.parse(u.state || '{}').books || []).length; } catch { /* broken JSON: count 0 */ } return { user: u.user, created: u.created, last: u.last, reads: u.reads, downloads: u.downloads, bugs: u.bugs, bookmarks: marks }; }) }, 200, cors);
      }
      if (path === '/admin/bugs') return json({ bugs: (await DB.prepare('SELECT id, user, t, title, report, page FROM bugs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?').bind(MAX_BUGS).all()).results }, 200, cors);
      if (path === '/admin/bug-delete') { await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM bugs WHERE id = ?').bind(+body.id || 0).run(); return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors); }
      const target = cleanName(body.u);
      if (!target) return json({ error: 'No such profile.' }, 400, cors);
      if (path === '/admin/user') {
        const items = (await DB.prepare('SELECT t, type, title, chapter, url, host FROM acts WHERE user = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?').bind(target, MAX_ACTS).all()).results.reverse();
        const s = await DB.prepare('SELECT json FROM state WHERE user = ?').bind(target).first();
        let state = {}; try { state = JSON.parse((s && s.json) || '{}'); } catch { /* broken JSON: show nothing */ }
        const bugs = (await DB.prepare('SELECT id, t, title, report, page FROM bugs WHERE user = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50').bind(target).all()).results;
        return json({ user: target, items, state, bugs }, 200, cors);
      }
      if (path === '/admin/delete') { await wipe(DB, target); return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors); }
      if (path === '/admin/reset') {
        const code = cleanCode(body.code), rec = await DB.prepare('SELECT name FROM users WHERE name = ?').bind(target).first();
        if (!code || !rec) return json({ error: 'Need a 6-digit code and an existing profile.' }, 400, cors);
        const salt = random(8);
        await DB.prepare('UPDATE users SET salt = ?, hash = ? WHERE name = ?').bind(salt, await fingerprint(env, salt, target, code), target).run();
        await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM fails WHERE name = ?').bind(target).run(); await DB.prepare('DELETE FROM tokens WHERE user = ?').bind(target).run();
        return json({ ok: true }, 200, cors);
      }
    }
    return json({ error: 'unknown route' }, 404, cors);
  }
};

// WHY: make and store a sign-in token. HOW: 24 random bytes as hex plus an expiry time. IMPROVE: none needed.
async function newToken(DB, user, role, now) {
  const token = random(24);
  await DB.prepare('INSERT INTO tokens (token, user, role, exp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)').bind(token, user, role, now + TOKEN_SECONDS * 1000).run();
  // WHY: give the new token back to the caller. HOW: it was stored in the tokens table just above.
  return token;
}
// WHY: delete everything of one profile. HOW: one batch over the five tables. IMPROVE: keep bug reports if you want to read them later.
async function wipe(DB, user) {
  await DB.batch(['users WHERE name', 'acts WHERE user', 'state WHERE user', 'bugs WHERE user', 'fails WHERE name'].map(t => DB.prepare('DELETE FROM ' + t + ' = ?').bind(user)));
}

# =====================================================================
# MangaFlow - _headers   (security headers for Netlify and Cloudflare Pages)
# WHY: a web page can only ask the browser to be careful with <meta> tags; real HTTP headers are stronger
#      and can also stop other sites from showing yours inside a frame (clickjacking).
# HOW: put this file next to index.html. Netlify and Cloudflare Pages read it by itself.
#      GitHub Pages ignores this file (it cannot set headers) - there the <meta> policy in index.html is used.
# ROUND 18: script-src and frame-src also list the three Google hosts that Google Programmable Search (cse.js) needs. Nothing else was opened.
# ROUND 32: script-src also lists 'wasm-unsafe-eval' (the text reader of the Translate add-on is a WebAssembly program; this does NOT allow eval() or inline scripts).
# IMPROVE: replace  connect-src *  with the exact addresses of your own proxy once you only use that.
# =====================================================================
/*
  Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' https://*.google.com https://*.google.co.in https://*.googleapis.com https://*.gstatic.com https://*.googlesyndication.com https://*.googleadservices.com https://*.doubleclick.net https://*.syndicatedsearch.goog https://syndicatedsearch.goog https://cse.google.com https://www.google.com https://www.gstatic.com https://clients1.google.com https://clients1.google.co.in https://*.google.com https://partner.googleadservices.com https://*.googleadservices.com https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://*.googlesyndication.com https://syndicatedsearch.goog https://*.syndicatedsearch.goog; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; img-src * data: blob:; media-src * blob:; font-src * data:; connect-src *; frame-src 'self' about: blob: data: https://*.google.com https://*.google.co.in https://*.googleapis.com https://*.gstatic.com https://*.googlesyndication.com https://*.googleadservices.com https://*.doubleclick.net https://*.syndicatedsearch.goog https://syndicatedsearch.goog https://www.google.com https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net https://syndicatedsearch.goog https://*.syndicatedsearch.goog https://*.google.com https://*.googlesyndication.com; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
  X-Frame-Options: DENY
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
  Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=()
  Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin
  Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000

# MangaFlow — Options Guide (buttons, shortcuts, settings, servers, troubleshoot, fix notes)

*Core file. Keep it next to `MANGAFLOW.md` (history + code map) and `MANGAFLOW_FULL_SITE.md` (all code). A plain-text copy is `MANGAFLOW_GUIDE.txt` (same content).*
*Last updated: Round 69 — 2026-11-14*

## HOW TO KEEP THIS FILE UP TO DATE (rule for every future update)
1. Every time a button, shortcut, setting, server option, troubleshoot check or algorithm is added or changed, change its line here in the same update.
2. Every time an ERROR is fixed, put a note on that line in this form: `FIX NOTE (Round N): it used to <problem>; now <what happens>.` Keep old notes (they are the history).
3. NEVER write private things here: no server addresses of the owner, no profile names, no passwords, no keys or IDs. Use placeholders such as `<your Cloudflare proxy>`.
4. Only HTML, CSS and JavaScript are used. Nothing else is needed to run the site.

## 0. Page names (how we talk about the site)
- **Page 1** = start page (search box, recent list, Paste / clipboard list, search engine picker).
- **Page 2** = site view (a mini browser showing the outside manga page; its scripts are blocked, MangaFlow draws what it needs).
- **Page 3** = reading mode (chapters one under another, endless scroll).

## 1. Buttons
### 1.1 Top bar (Page 1 and Page 2)
| Button | What it does / how it works |
|---|---|
| Back / Forward | Moves through the pages opened inside MangaFlow (also works with the phone's own Back). FIX NOTE (Round 53): Forward after Back used to do nothing; now works. |
| Reload | Loads the current page again (clears its saved copy first). |
| Start page (home) | Goes to Page 1. |
| Address box + search pill | Paste a manga link (opens it; if chapters exist it may open reading mode) or type a name (searches with the chosen search engine). |
| Bookmark star | Adds / removes the page from bookmarks (saved in the profile). FIX NOTE (Round 41): bookmarks could be added but not removed; now removable. |
| White/Black | Switches the theme. |
| Full screen | Hides the bars; Esc leaves. |
| Settings | Opens the settings window (section 3). |
| Open on original site | Opens the real page in a new browser tab. |
| Report / Open original / Dismiss (page note) | Small note shown when a page looks wrong: send a report, open the real site, or close the note. |

### 1.2 Page 1 (start page)
| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| Paste (clipboard icon) | Pastes the copied link or words into the box. |
| Clipboard list (arrow) | Shows the last copied links to pick from. |
| Search engine picker | Chooses which engine is used for names (Google, DuckDuckGo, etc.). |
| Google | Searches the words with Google inside MangaFlow; "google.com" opens it in a tab; Close hides the panel. |

### 1.3 Page 2 floating buttons
| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| Reading mode (book icon, icon only) | Starts reading mode for this page. FIX NOTE (Round 56): used to show words and was too big; now a small icon. |
| Previous / Chapter list / Next (bottom bar) | MangaFlow's own chapter buttons for the site view. FIX NOTE (Round 56): sites with script-driven chapter bars (their Next/Prev did nothing here) are handled by the "button bridge" — the site's own Next / Previous / Chapters controls are recognised and made to work. FIX NOTE (Round 58): dead links like `#/next/` no longer cause an error. |

### 1.4 Reading mode (Page 3) bars and menus
| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| Home | Leaves reading and goes to Page 1 (also cleans the address). |
| Exit (Esc) | Leaves reading mode and opens the chapter you were on. |
| Chapters (C) | Chapter list menu to jump. |
| White/Black (T) | Theme. |
| Settings | Settings; also "clear chapter cache". |
| Address box (reading) | Paste another link or type a name without leaving reading mode first. |
| Menu: Download chapters (PDF), Full screen, Free memory | PDF maker, full screen, clears the chapter cache. |
| Load earlier chapters | Loads the chapters before the first one shown. |
| Top / Previous chapter / Next chapter / End | Jump to the top, previous chapter, next chapter, end of loaded chapters. FIX NOTE (Round 53): after a key jump the header could stay hidden; now shown at the top. |
| Full screen (and Exit full screen) | Full-screen reading. FIX NOTE (Round 53): Esc in full screen used to leave reading mode; now it only leaves full screen. |
| Downloads dock (icon, minimise) | Shows running PDF downloads; they keep running when minimised. |

### 1.5 Windows
| Window | Buttons |
|---|---|
| PDF maker | From / To chapter, split, mode, Cancel, Make PDF. |
| Search pop-up | Link/name box, Paste, clipboard list. |
| Error window | Close, Troubleshoot, Copy report. |
| Human check window | Open the site, "I did it – try again", Close (for sites that ask "are you a robot"). |

## 2. Keyboard shortcuts (reading mode)
| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Esc | Closes menus / leaves full screen / leaves reading mode (in that order). |
| N / P | Next / previous chapter. |
| T | Theme. |
| C | Chapter menu. |
| Left / Right arrows | Previous / next chapter (only when "Keys ← → change chapter" is on). |
| Home / End | Top / end of loaded chapters (hidden on purpose when the Slider or Edge add-on is on). |
| Up / Page Up at the very top | Loads earlier chapters. |
| F11 | Full screen (when the full-screen button setting is on). |
| Enter in the proxy box | Adds the proxy. |

## 3. Settings (window "Settings")
- **Reading:** page width, chapter-bar side (left/right), PDF quality, Chapter slider, Reload wheel, Keep screen awake (turns off after a reload), Open manga link straight in reading mode (auto-read), Load chapters ahead (how many), Keys ← →, Tap to scroll (top = up), Full-screen button, Top/End slider (edge).
- **Search:** Search engine, Google search ID and key (private — stored only in the browser), Test Google search, "Copy my sites for Google", Only use the engine I chose, Open search straight after Paste, add the word "manga" to Google searches. FIX NOTE (Round 47/49): the owner's own address and old key must never be written in files.
- **Translate add-on:** button on/off, language to translate into, language written on pages, engine, start automatically, Test translate.
- **Profile (accounts add-on):** Open my profile, Sync now (history, bookmarks synced to the accounts server). Tabs: My history, Bookmarks, and (admin) All profiles, Reports, Server. **Reports tab:** each report can be opened ("show report"), **Copied** (Copy button, Round 62 — copies title, user, page and the whole report; works even when the phone blocks the clipboard) or Deleted (admin). Profile names and passwords are NOT listed in any file.
- **Memory / history:** Clear a range of chapters, clear all before my chapter, automatic clearing, "Do not save my reading history", "Erase history and cache when I close this tab", Clear history & cache.
- **Servers (proxies):** list of picture/page proxies, Add, Test all, Reset to defaults (see section 4).
- **Troubleshoot:** see section 5. Reset settings puts every setting back to default.

## 4. Server options (generic — no private names)
- **Proxy server (Cloudflare Worker, `worker.js`):** `<your Cloudflare proxy>/?url={url}&ref=<page address>`. Fetches pages and pictures for MangaFlow because browsers block direct access. `&ref=` sends the chapter page as Referer so picture hosts that check it answer. Optional allow-list `ALLOWED` limits which sites it will fetch.
- **Public proxies (backup):** a few free public proxy services are tried when your own proxy fails. They cannot send a Referer.
- **Accounts server (Cloudflare Worker + D1 database, `accounts-worker.js`):** sign-in, history/bookmark sync, and receiving "Send report to server". Passwords are never shown to the page or stored in files.
- **Picture routes (reading mode):** direct → your proxy with Referer → other proxies → image resizer service; the first that works is used.
- **Hosting:** GitHub Pages (static files). Cache busting uses `?v=NN` in `index.html`; raise NN every update. FIX NOTE (Round 42): updates seemed "not to arrive" because browsers kept old files; version numbers fixed that.

## 5. Troubleshoot (Settings → Troubleshoot)
| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| Run checks | Tests browser features, proxies, downloads and (new, Round 59) the site view: lists named problems with codes. Round 62 adds reading-mode rows `RD-LIST-SERIES-LINKS` (the chapter list holds other manga's pages) and `RD-MANY-EMPTY` (half or more chapter boxes empty). |
| Fix automatically | Clears caches, tests proxies, repairs reading-mode pictures/boxes, cancels stuck work, and runs the Site-View Doctor. If something cannot be fixed it builds the COMPLETE error report, shows it in a box and copies it. |
| Symptoms & answers | A guide of common problems with fixes. |
| Copy full report / Send report to server | The full report (includes the Page 2 detail) for you, Claude or any AI. |
| Reset settings | Back to defaults. |

**Site-View Doctor codes (Page 2):** `P2-HIDDEN` (loaded but not visible), `P2-COVER` (a cover hides the page), `P2-PLACEHOLDER` (spinner/empty slots), `P2-MISSING` (fewer pictures than the reader finder knows), `P2-FAILED` (pictures failed), `P2-STALLED` (pictures still loading after 12 s), `P2-STUCK-LOADING` (loading note that never ends), `P2-NOLIST`, `P2-NODOC`.
**Automatic algorithms (nothing to press):**
- *Visibility doctor (Round 63):* checks how each chapter picture is really drawn; un-hides it, removes "loading / JavaScript required" covers, or draws a plain strip of the chapter. Runs at 0.8, 2, 3.5 s and with the watchdog.
- *Reading speed (Round 63):* the first pictures of the current and next chapter load at once; the preloader runs more pictures in parallel on good connections and reacts on every chapter change.
- *Picture watchdog (Round 61):* after a site page appears it looks at 4, 9, 16, 28, 45, 70 s; failed pictures are restarted at once, hanging pictures after 9 s, through your proxy (with Referer), other proxies, then the same address with a changing word. From the 2nd look it also runs the quiet Doctor repair. Stops when all pictures are loaded or when you leave.
- *Placeholder rule (Round 59):* spinner pictures such as `readerarea.svg` count as EMPTY slots and are filled with the real chapter pictures (in the correct order, Round 60).
- *Chapter audit (Round 55):* detects missing/jumping chapter numbers (e.g. 1 then 22) and reports/repairs them.
- *Quiet detection (Round 60):* the check "is this a manga? open reading mode" runs in the background, shows only a small non-blocking note, and stops as soon as you touch the page.

## 6. Add-ons
*Translate algorithm (Round 65):* prepare picture → read (second black/white reading if empty) → drop unsure words → repair reading mistakes → drop noise → story order → one in-context request per page → check answer → tidy.

Chapter slider, Reload wheel, Edge (Top/End) slider, Translate, Profiles. Each can be turned off in Settings. Files: `chapter-slider.js`, `reload-wheel.js`, `edge-slider.js`, `translate.js`, `profiles.js`.

## 7. Fix notes by round (what was broken → what happens now)
- **Round 38–42:** chapter lists incomplete (all chapters now load); history delete/date filter/export on phones; keep-screen-awake stopping; header hiding too eagerly; bookmarks not removable; old files cached (version numbers added).
- **Round 43:** full audit of app, profiles, translate and style files (many small bugs fixed; see `MANGAFLOW.md`).
- **Round 45–46:** chapter errors from reports; refresh on Page 1 reopened the last chapter (now stays on Page 1); roliascan picture API.
- **Round 47/49:** sign-in problems fixed; owner's server address removed from visible text.
- **Round 50–52:** Page 2 chapter pages show all pictures; hotlink-protected pictures load through the proxy with Referer; stuck/empty chapter boxes recovered.
- **Round 53:** whole-site audit of every button, shortcut, setting, profile and server option (Forward, Esc in full screen, header at top fixed).
- **Round 54:** one-picture chapters accepted; false "font" warning fixed.
- **Round 55:** chapter audit — no silent jump from chapter 1 to 22.
- **Round 56:** icon-only Reading button; button bridge for script-driven chapter bars.
- **Round 57–58:** "Page 2 keeps loading"; chapter list 1..N; dead `#/next/` links.
- **Round 59:** Page 2 showed only a spinner (placeholder pictures were counted as real) → fixed; Site-View Doctor added to Troubleshoot with full error report.
- **Round 60:** added pages were placed after sidebar thumbnails → correct order; the "working" note covered the whole screen and blocked the site → small non-blocking note; detection stops when you touch the page.
- **Round 61:** some Page 2 pictures hung until "Fix automatically" was pressed → picture watchdog does it automatically; this guide added.
- **Round 62:** a "Related Series" box (links to OTHER manga labelled "Chapter 74") was read as the chapter list, so reading mode showed 8 empty "chapters" and the pop-up named chapters that never existed → such series-page links are now ignored, the real series page is found (also for names ending in -2 or -chapter-14), and chapters written in two address styles are joined into one list. Profile → Reports got a Copy button.
- **Round 63:** script-built sites (Next.js, e.g. drakecomic) keep the reader hidden until their own script runs, so Page 2 showed a blank page / "JavaScript Required" cover although the pictures were loaded → MangaFlow now makes them visible (and removes the cover) by itself, or draws the chapter in a plain strip; the reader name "JavaScript Required" fixed; style sheets repaired up to 24 (was 8) with a second try; pictures start sooner in reading mode.
- **Round 64:** the warning "1 style sheet could not be loaded, so the page may look plain" appeared even when the browser loaded that file fine or the site itself had no such file → such cases are no longer warned; a real failure now lists why each proxy failed.
- **Round 65:** translated words were often wrong or meaningless because the picture text was read from the raw picture (for example the word "I" read as "|") and answers were never checked → the reader now prepares the picture (grey, contrast, white-on-black turned round, small pages enlarged, second black/white reading), repairs typical reading mistakes, ignores noise, puts bubbles in story order (right-to-left for Japanese), translates the whole page in one request in context, refuses bad answers (empty / untranslated / wrong writing) and asks the next service, then tidies the text. A translator that hangs is given up after 20–40 s.
- **Round 66:** some chapters showed dozens of red "Page N could not be loaded" boxes because the site's old upload of the chapter has deleted pictures (the site's own list shows a newer copy) -> the dead-upload doctor now runs by itself while you read and skips such old copies quietly; pressing the site's own "Previous" on chapter 1 (a page that does not exist) now only shows a small note; the "pictures hidden" check no longer raises a false alarm while reading, and a spare placeholder slot is no longer reported.

- **Round 67: the site's re-uploaded chapters (chapter-3-2) were read as "chapter 3.2" and the reader then guessed a "missing" chapter 3 whose pictures are dead -> "-2" copies are now chapter 3 (no guessed dead copy); a background AutoPilot (every 10 s) now repairs ALL loaded chapters by itself (dead uploads, boxes with messages, long waits, proxies, stuck loaders, Page 2 pictures) and "Fix automatically" now also looks at the chapters ahead.

- **Round 68: the site felt slower because the new background AutoPilot asked the network up to 4x more on pages with dead pictures (measured with a profiler mock) -> it now waits for the page's own watchdog, restarts each picture at most twice, only scans when the picture situation changed and repairs at most 3 times per page.

- **Round 69: preloaded chapters were still slow (hanging pictures used up the download slots; refill only every 0.8 s; each batch waited for its slowest chapter) -> a new preload engine marks stalled pictures, restarts them by another route, refills at once and adapts the number of parallel downloads. Translation: new optional "Smart AI translator" (Gemini / Claude / OpenAI key typed in the Translate panel, kept only in your browser) translates a whole page in one request with context and fixes OCR typos; the normal services stay as fallback.**

- **Round 69b: kingofshojo showed 'Could not load Chapter 6/37/48/…' because a sidebar of OTHER manga (links to their main pages, with the text 'Chapter 6') was taken as the chapter list -> a series fence removes any link to another manga's main page from every chapter list (and quietly drops one if it ever slips through); a chapter address the site answers with an unrelated page now gets an honest message.**

## 8. Known open items
- Replace/revoke any old Google key that was ever shown in a report.
- Fill the proxy's `ALLOWED` list if you want to restrict it.
- Sites with strong bot checks may still need the "Human check" window.
